terminal_warning: This is a terminal on the server, with the hub account's permissions.
terminal_warning_detail: Whatever you type runs on the hub's host as the hub's own user, in the profile's folder. Opening and closing a terminal is written to the logs.
terminal_no_pty: This hub has no PTY: commands run and print, but there is no line editing and full-screen programs do not work.
terminal_idle: A terminal nobody types in closes after %1$s minutes. At most %2$s are open at once.
terminal_limit: %1$s terminals are open already. Close one first.
terminal_empty_body: A new terminal starts in the %1$s profile's folder.
terminal_disabled: The terminal is not enabled on this hub.
terminal_disabled_body: It is off unless the hub is started with COREHUB_WEB_TERMINAL=1, and even then only the owner sees it.
terminal_gone: This terminal is no longer on the hub.
